reviews.question:
Some people believe that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that children can benefit more from reading stories than watching TV or playing computer games. Personally, I agree with this opinion because reading stories can improve children’s language skills and develop their imagination.

Initially, reading stories can help children improve their language ability and understand knowledge more effectively. This is because stories contain descriptions and conversations in different situations, which introduce children to a variety of words, expressions and grammatical structures. As a result, they can improve their understanding of language. In comparison, spoken language in TV programmes is often less diverse and complex than written stories. Although computer games can help children learn new words, their texts mainly explain how to win or complete missions. Therefore, reading stories may provide children with more useful language knowledge.

Furthermore, reading stories can develop children’s imagination. When reading fictional or real-life stories, children can create pictures of the characters and events in their minds. For example, they may imagine a wonderful world or picture the suffering of a homeless person, which can increase their creativity and understanding of others. In contrast, TV programmes show images created by other people, so children mainly observe what appears on the screen. Similarly, computer games often require players to follow strategies and use previous experience to complete tasks, giving them fewer opportunities to create an imaginary world independently.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that reading stories is more beneficial for children than watching TV or playing computer games because it improves their language skills and allows them to develop their imagination.
reviews.overall: Em viết 258 từ, nêu rõ quan điểm và triển khai hai Body đúng theo ngôn ngữ, trí tưởng tượng. Body 2 có chuỗi tự hình dung cùng hai phép đối chiếu TV, game khá đầy đủ. Body 1 cần sửa ba chỗ: dùng absorb knowledge thay vì understand knowledge; nói rõ TV cũng có thể dạy từ mới trước khi so độ đa dạng của ngôn ngữ; và giải thích vì sao chữ trong game chỉ quanh bối cảnh trò chơi nên hẹp hơn truyện. Em hoàn thiện các mắt xích này rồi tự soát vế so sánh.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
It is argued that children can benefit more from reading stories than watching TV or playing computer games. Personally, I agree with this opinion because reading stories can improve children’s language skills and develop their imagination.

Initially, reading stories can help children improve their language ability and absorb knowledge about different situations more effectively. This is because stories contain descriptions and conversations in varied settings, which introduce children to a range of words, expressions and grammatical structures and help them understand unfamiliar experiences. Although TV programmes may also teach children new words, expressions and grammatical structures, their spoken language is often less diverse and complex than the language in written stories. Computer games may require children to read instructions about how to win or complete missions, but these texts mainly concern the game's context, whereas stories expose them to many aspects of life. Therefore, reading stories may offer children richer language and broader knowledge than either screen-based activity.

Furthermore, reading stories can develop children’s imagination. When reading fictional or real-life stories, children can create pictures of the characters and events in their minds. For example, they may imagine a wonderful world or picture the suffering of a homeless person, which can increase their creativity and understanding of others. In contrast, TV programmes show images created by other people, so children mainly observe what appears on the screen. Similarly, computer games often require players to follow strategies and use previous experience to complete tasks, giving them fewer opportunities to create an imaginary world independently.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that reading stories is more beneficial for children than watching TV or playing computer games because it improves their language skills and allows them to develop their imagination.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some argue that advertising has beneficial impacts for economy, others believe it has harmful effects on society because it make people annoyed with who they are and what they have. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

One might argue that advertising brings undeniable economic benefits. It creates creative content and appealing visual effects, which stimulate consumer demand and help spending power is increase. Because of that, production is encouraged and creates more employment opportunities for residents and greater state revenues through taxation. It naturally follows that a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms say Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Moreover, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design. It make it an important driver of economic activity.

So the argument goes advertising has negative social consequences. It constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions, which foster dissatisfaction among viewers. For instance, young people who is the easiest affect in particular feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. Therefore it leads to frustration when they cannot afford them. This naturally follows that advertising promotes materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
Overall, I believe both views have valid to some certain extent advertising would contribute to social dissatisfaction, whereas, plays a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ bốn phần trên ảnh.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần và giữ được nhiều ý đúng của dàn ý, đặc biệt ví dụ Shopee/Lazada. Tuy nhiên, em dùng nhiều câu rời và nối bằng ‘Because of that’ hoặc ‘Therefore’, khiến mạch lập luận bị gãy; cần viết lại để tự soát lỗi cơ bản.

paragraphs: Some people argue that advertising has beneficial economic impacts, whereas others believe that it has harmful effects on society by making people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have. There are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

On the one hand, supporters of advertising often point to the undeniable economic benefits it can bring. Creative content and appealing visual effects stimulate consumer demand. This can increase spending power and encourage production, which creates more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation. It naturally follows that the economy becomes stronger. For example, e-commerce platforms, say, Shopee and Lazada in Vietnam, rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting both their sales and the entire digital retail sector. Moreover, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media, and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

Those on the other side of the debate, however, argue that advertising entails negative social consequences. It constantly shows images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, and luxury possessions, which can foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook. Frustration can arise when they cannot afford these products. In the long run, advertising can promote materialistic values and a money-driven culture.
In conclusion, I believe both views are valid to a certain extent. Advertising can contribute to social dissatisfaction, whereas it also plays a crucial role in economic development.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
